subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Steps for personal hygiene: correct tooth brushing (small tooth-brushing book)

show.line: Brush, brush, brush your teeth! Up and down, round and round. Morning and night!

rounds.prompt: When do we brush our teeth?
Toothpaste on the brush, brush all teeth, and then?
Which food is kind to our teeth?
rounds.praise: An apple! Crunchy and good for teeth.

rounds.prompt: Who helps us look after our teeth? It starts with d.
Good for teeth, or bad for teeth? Sort them.

hints: Sweets stick to teeth. Brushing cleans them off.
Brush twice a day, in the morning and at night.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will brush my teeth.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I only brush on my birthday!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! We brush every morning and every night.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Every day, morning and night. Brush, brush!

parent_line: Knows how and when to brush teeth.
